name: director-for-paseo
description: Director for Paseo host package and standalone Director Engine scaffold

scripts.build: npm run build:engine && npm run typecheck
scripts.ci: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run contract:check && npm run architecture:check && npm run build && npm run test:engine && npm run test:host && npm run smoke && npm run test:baseline
scripts.contract:check: node --test tools/ci/contract-check.test.mjs && node tools/ci/contract-check.mjs && npm run threat-model:check
scripts.contract:generate: go -C engine run ./cmd/generate-host-client --schema ports/host/host-interface.v1.json --output ../generated/host-contract.shared.ts && go -C engine run ./cmd/generate-planning-client --schema ports/planning/planning-surface.v1.json --output ../generated/planning-contract.shared.ts && go -C engine run ./cmd/generate-agent-mcp-client --schema domain/agentbridge/schemas/director-agent-mcp.v1.json --output ../generated/agent-mcp-contract.shared.ts
scripts.lint: node tools/ci/scaffold-check.mjs lint && npm run engine:check && go -C engine vet ./...
scripts.test: npm run test:engine && npm run test:host && npm run smoke
scripts.test:baseline: node tools/spikes/dir-m0.10/effect-contract.mjs && node tools/spikes/dir-m0.10/guard-mutations.mjs && node tools/spikes/dir-m0.6/worktree-ownership.mjs --state-fsync-fixture && node tools/spikes/dir-m0.7/github-delivery.mjs --self-test && node docs/evidence/m0.14/practical-boundary-contract.mjs && node tools/spikes/dir-m0.17/ignored-tree-policy.mjs --timeout-probe
scripts.threat-model:check: node --test tools/ci/threat-model-check.test.mjs tools/ci/credential-fixture-check.test.mjs && node tools/ci/threat-model-check.mjs && node tools/ci/credential-fixture-check.mjs
